review_candidates.title: Investor Relation & Corporate Finance Manager
review_candidates.description: Investor Relations & Corporate Finance Manager About The Job At FUSE, we believe strong investor communication and financial strategy are critical to supporting sustainable growth and long-term decision-making. We are looking for an Investor Relations & Corporate Finance Manager who can turn financial and business data into clear, compelling stories and confidently communicate them to investors and senior management . This is a highly investor-facing role. While financial data, analysis, and supporting materials are prepared together with the relevant internal teams, you will be expected to deeply understand the numbers, identify the key business insights, and present the story clearly and confidently to investors, the Executive Team, and the Board. This role will work closely with the Executive Team, Finance, and cross-functional stakeholders to manage investor communications, support fundraising initiatives, analyze business performance, and contribute to strategic financial planning. What You'll Do Investor Relations & Communication Own day-to-day communication and relationship management with existing and potential investors. Present FUSE's business and financial performance to investors with confidence, clarity, and strong business storytelling. Translate financial and operational data into clear narratives, key messages, and actionable insights for investors, the Executive Team, and the Board of Directors. Prepare and deliver investor updates, business performance reviews, financial presentations, and executive-level materials. Act as a key point of contact for investor questions and coordinate with internal teams to provide accurate, timely, and well-articulated responses. Anticipate potential investor questions and proactively identify the key messages, risks, and areas requiring further explanation. Build and maintain strong relationships with investors and understand their key areas of interest and concerns. Financial Analysis & Business Insight Analyze financial statements, business performance, KPIs, and key business drivers to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and areas requiring management attention. Develop a strong understanding of the underlying data and business drivers, rather than simply reporting numbers. Work with Finance and business teams to validate data, investigate variances, and ensure the accuracy and consistency of information presented to investors. Develop and maintain financial models, forecasts, and scenario analyses to support fundraising, strategic planning, and investment decisions. Support budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning processes. Use data to develop clear recommendations and insights for senior management. Fundraising & Strategic Finance Support fundraising activities, including investor presentations, financial information preparation, data room management, due diligence, and investor engagement. Coordinate with Finance, Legal, and other relevant teams throughout fundraising and due diligence processes. Support preparation of fundraising materials, financial analyses, and investor-related documentation. Conduct industry research, competitor benchmarking, and market analysis to support investor messaging and strategic initiatives. Support other corporate finance initiatives, including investment evaluation, M&A, due diligence, and strategic transactions when required. What We're Looking For Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field. 5–8 years of relevant experience in Investor Relations, Corporate Finance, Investment Banking, Transaction Advisory, Financial Advisory, Strategic Finance, or related roles. Strong presentation and communication skills, with proven experience presenting business or financial performance to investors, senior management, or Board-level stakeholders. Confident and articulate in front of investors, able to explain complex financial or business topics clearly, handle questions, and communicate with credibility. Strong foundation in Accounting and Finance, with a solid understanding of financial statements and business performance. Strong data sense and analytical thinking, able to look beyond the numbers, identify what matters, and understand the business story behind the data. Strong Excel skills and the ability to independently analyze, manipulate, and interpret financial and business data. Strong financial modeling capabilities and experience working with forecasts, budgets, and scenario analyses. Ability to translate complex financial information into clear, concise, and investor-friendly narratives. Excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to work effectively with senior management and cross-functional teams. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both English and Bahasa Indonesia. Strong business acumen, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment. Preferred Qualifications Experience in Investor Relations within technology, fintech, startups, financial services, or publicly listed companies. Experience regularly presenting to investors, shareholders, Board members, or other senior external stakeholders. Experience supporting fundraising, Series funding, private placements, debt or equity financing, or other capital-raising activities. Previous experience in Big Four, investment banking, private equity, venture capital, transaction advisory, financial advisory, or strategic finance. Experience preparing investor decks, Board materials, fundraising materials, and financial models. Professional certifications such as CFA, CPA, CA, or FMVA are a plus

Validation, vérification & certification Conduire les activités de validation et vérification dans le respect des normes civiles et qualifications militaires. Rooted deeply in pedagogy, this role is designed for a researcher-practitioner who understands how people learn and wants to apply that knowledge to shape the future of K-12 education across ESF. The primary lens for this role is pedagogical efficacy . You will leverage your understanding of cognitive science, learning theories, and educational research methodologies to design, prototype, and evaluate digital learning interventions. Rather than acting as a traditional software engineer, you will utilize modern Generative AI and AI-assisted programming tools ("vibe coding") as a lever to rapidly bring research-backed educational tools to life, measuring their impact on teaching and learning through rigorous data analysis. Key Responsibilities Pedagogically-Driven Prototyping & AI Realization Translate established learning theories (e.g., cognitive load theory, constructivism, retrieval practice) and pedagogical strategies into functional digital tools and prototypes. Utilize Generative AI and AI-assisted development workflows to rapidly build and deploy lightweight, proof-of-concept tools (e.g., targeted formative assessment assistants, scaffolding tools, or adaptive learning prompts) without needing a formal computer science background. Design human-AI collaboration frameworks for the classroom that position technology as an encoder of sound pedagogy, ensuring AI interventions support rather than disrupt the teacher-student dynamic. Educational Research & Learning Analytics Design and execute rigorous, localized research studies—such as Design-Based Implementation Research (DBIR) and experimental/quasi-experimental designs—to evaluate the classroom impact of educational tools. Architect learning analytics frameworks and event-logging infrastructure within prototypes to capture meaningful indicators of student engagement, conceptual understanding, and learning trajectories. Apply advanced statistical methods (e.g., regression analysis, mixed-methods analysis) to synthesize quantitative behavioral data with qualitative classroom observations and teacher interviews. Apply contemporary classroom assessment theories to design tools that provide actionable, high-quality formative feedback to students and diagnostic insights to teachers. The standing target is at least five scheduled tours for every ten inquiries. Answer parent emails daily in a tone that reflects how the center treats its families. Enter daily attendance in ProCare for both campuses. Pull attendance from ProCare and maintain a combined attendance spreadsheet in Excel covering both campuses. Enter daily meal counts into the Kid Care food program using ProCare attendance. Breakfast at 8:55 a.m., lunch at 11:00 a.m., and afternoon snack at 2:30 p.m., for both campuses. Enter school menus into ProCare for both campuses. Add events, closures, and important dates to the center calendar. Create flyers in Canva for events, enrollment promotions, and parent announcements. Assist in all digital marketing efforts such as website updates, social media posts, simple video editing, etc. Place grocery and supply orders through Instacart and Performance Foodservice. Additional tasks as the role grows. What We're Looking For Two or more years in an executive assistant or customer service roles. Excellent written and spoken English. Parents will judge the school by your communication. A warm, professional communication style. First impressions carry weight in a business built on trust. Deadline driven with strong attention to detail. Attendance and meal counts are entered on time every day without reminders. Comfortable working toward a number and reporting on it honestly each week. Intermediate Excel skills, including sorting, filtering, basic formulas, and building clean summary sheets. Experience using a customer relationship management system to track leads and follow up. Highly reliable. Availability for live coordination during United States Central Time business hours. Nice to Have Experience in childcare, education, healthcare, or another service business built on client trust. Hands on experience with ProCare. Familiarity with food program reporting such as the Child and Adult Care Food Program. Canva design experience. Experience with online ordering platforms such as Instacart. Administrative support experience with a nonprofit organization. How This Role Works You report directly to the owner, who also serves as school director. By day 30, you handle new inquiries and book tours independently, and daily attendance and meal counts are entered on time, and the food menus. By day 60, you own the parent email inbox, the attendance spreadsheet, the calendar, and tour bookings are consistently at target. By day 90, you anticipate what is coming, run the recurring back-office processes without any prompting, and the owner spends measurably less time on follow-up and administration.

review_candidates.title: Event Operations Manager
review_candidates.description: Role: Event Operations Manager Location: Remote (LATAM-based welcome), with regular travel to the United States required to support on-site events ABOUT COSIGN Cosign is the fastest growing prop-tech company in the United States revolutionizing the $4 trillion rental industry with a market-leading one-of-a-kind rent guarantee product. Our mission is to expand housing access for renters and boost occupancy for landlords. Backed by top entrepreneurs, venture capital firms, and real estate investors, Cosign is built by experienced landlords and managers for landlords and managers who deeply understand the rental market’s needs. OUR MISSION CONTINUED Cosign is on a mission to expand access to housing by helping landlords approve more qualified renters - without increasing risk. We partner with owners and property managers to close the qualification gap caused by conditional approvals, thin credit files, and the absence of guarantors, materially improving leasing conversion and occupancy. We’re building toward a near future where every U.S. property offers Cosign to renters who struggle to qualify - expanding housing choice while helping owners and operators convert demand into signed leases. OUR HIRING PHILOSOPHY At Cosign, we seek exceptional talent with relentless intellectual curiosity - individuals who: • Challenge the status quo and drive continuous improvement • Demand excellence from themselves and their colleagues • Identify and solve problems others don't even recognize • Create innovative solutions others believe impossible We deliberately seek these rare, high-impact performers who attract similar talent. While most companies avoid hiring these exceptional individuals due to their demanding nature, we actively pursue them. When we find someone extraordinary, we move quickly to bring them onboard. We believe average talent builds average companies. By assembling a team of exceptional performers, we're creating the talent density needed to transform the rental industry and set new standards of excellence. THE OPPORTUNITY Calling all logistics obsessives and client-experience builders. We are looking for a hands-on, detail-driven, and proactive Event Operations Manager to own end-to-end logistics for our client-facing events and travel program from the ground up, supporting 100+ events per year. This is a founding operations role where you will own every piece of getting the team where they need to be, prepared, and ready to represent Cosign in front of clients and partners. As the first dedicated hire in this seat, you will own the entire stack: travel booking, event calendaring, agenda communication, client dinners and activities, booth installation and supervision, partner billing coordination, and ad-hoc gifting. You will work directly with Sales Operations and leadership to turn client-facing events into a well-oiled, high-touch operation, with every event tied to a seamless client experience. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a startup environment, has run high-volume event and travel logistics before, is comfortable owning vendor and partner relationships end-to-end, and is excited to own this function in a fast-moving, early-stage context. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES • Own the events and travel logistics engine across the business: booking flights, hotels, and rental cars for team members attending 100+ events per year, well ahead of each event date. • Maintain a rolling calendar of all events, tracking booking deadlines, confirmations, and any changes, and sending the team a clear pre-event agenda ahead of every event. • Coordinate directly with the Sales Operations team to align event logistics with account and pipeline priorities. • Serve as the point person for all client-related activities - every client touchpoint at an event runs through this role. • Plan and facilitate company events, activities and dinners end-to-end, including setting up invites via Luma/Partiful. • Evaluate restaurant options and activity ideas for client dinners and outings, balancing quality, location, and budget. • Correspond with partner companies on billing and logistics for co-hosted or co-sponsored events. • Own ad-hoc client and team gifting end-to-end - sourcing, ordering, and ensuring timely delivery. • A function that flexes with the business: stepping into adjacent client-experience and ad hoc projects as needed in an early-stage, fast-moving environment. • Maintain a detailed, structured expenditure ledger to ensure seamless financial reconciliation with the accounting team. ABOUT YOU As a highly organized and detail-driven Event Operations Manager, you take full ownership of events, travel, and accommodations, from initial booking through final send-off, without needing direction. You are deeply committed to getting every detail right, remain structured under pressure, and never let a booking deadline or client touchpoint slip. You thrive in early-stage landscapes where processes are still evolving. Instead of seeing gaps as obstacles, you view them as chances to build better systems, bring fresh ideas, and find energy in constructing something new rather than simply working inside it. You are a logistics and client-experience wizard, comfortable running multiple bookings and events at once, owning vendor and partner relationships, and making sure every client interaction feels seamless and well thought out. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE We are looking for a passionate, experienced operator who is excited about building a client-events function that has never been built before. • 3+ years of experience in event planning, travel coordination, executive support, or client experience roles; startup, proptech, fintech, or insurtech experience is a plus but not necessary • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent bookings and deadlines without dropping details • Comfortable owning vendor and partner relationships, including billing and invoicing conversations • Strong written communication - comfortable sending clear, well-organized agendas and updates to a team • Experience with event platforms like Luma or Partiful, or similar tools, is a plus • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and calm under pressure when plans change last minute • Willingness to travel frequently, including internationally, to support on-site events • Must have current authorization to travel to the United States (e.g., a valid U.S. visitor visa or visa-free entry eligibility), and be able to maintain that authorization, as regular U.S. travel is a core requirement of this role WHAT MAKES THIS OPPORTUNITY DIFFERENT This is an opportunity to join one of the fastest-growing companies in U.S. PropTech at a pivotal moment in our growth. You will play a direct role in shaping how Cosign shows up for clients and partners in person, helping housing providers create better experiences for residents, renters, and property teams across the country. You will work alongside a team of exceptional performers, have direct access to senior leadership, and have real ownership over outcomes from day one. We move fast, we take care of our people, and we are building something that genuinely matters. WORKING AT COSIGN This is a remote position, with regular travel to the United States required to support major on-site events throughout the year. Cosign is looking for someone who is comfortable operating with pace, accountability, and a high degree of ownership. The right person will be energized by the opportunity to build structure within a growing business and create a lasting impact on how its client events run.
